questions.stem: Describe the process of deleting a node with one child in a BST.
markingGuide: Identify that the child node replaces the node to be deleted.
Explain that this maintains the BST property.

questions.explanation: When deleting a node with one child, the child node takes the place of the node to be deleted. This maintains the BST invariant as the child is either greater or less than the parent, depending on its position. The parent node is re-linked to the child node.
